read_only_sources.industry_field: Indcat; modal 2017-2019 value with lexicographic tie-breaking

validation: Partner country uses valid two-letter codes and excludes CN and XZ
Readiness uses supplier links and foreign RCEP countries only
Exposure is constant within firm and uses 2017-2019 only
Transition outcomes agree with pair-level active histories
All missing outcomes follow the frozen zero/missing rules
known_limitations: Relationship intensity is unavailable for most links.
FactSet coverage is not a census of private supply-chain relationships.
Observed relationship records may contain overlapping episodes already collapsed in the pair-year source.
No direct measure of certificates of origin or RCEP preference utilization is available.
